hero.roka_mark.name: Márk "Fox" Szabó
hero.roka_mark.description: Three years ago he tore apart billionaires' fake claims; nowadays he only takes cases with good booze or a juicy scandal. Wickedly sharp and usually spots a lie before you finish telling it.
card.apro_reszlet.name: One Small Detail…
card.apro_reszlet.description: Once per adventure, automatically succeed on a Wits or Charm check.
hero.varga_vera.name: Vera Varga
hero.varga_vera.description: She prefers to call it 'redistributing poorly secured assets.' No grate, ledge, or laser grid can hold her for long — though the cold grip of time jumps still rattles her nerves.
card.b_terv.name: Plan B Out the Window
card.b_terv.description: Once per adventure, reroll a failed Agility or Luck check.
hero.doki_gabor.name: Dr. Gábor "Doc" Kovács
hero.doki_gabor.description: Forty-five, wears a battered trench coat, and hasn't felt his pulse spike since his first morgue shift. His charm is as subtle as a dull scalpel, but his hands never shake.
card.ket_ujjnyi_konyak.name: Two Fingers of Cognac
card.ket_ujjnyi_konyak.description: Once per adventure, heal +5 HP or automatically succeed on a Nerve check.
item.torott_oralanc.name: Broken Watch Chain
item.torott_oralanc.description: A warm, faintly tingling gold chain torn off the vanished Kálmán Chronometer. Helps anchor your mind in the time vortex (+1 Nerve on the first time jump and in the finale).
item.parfumos_level.name: Perfumed Letter
item.parfumos_level.description: Red Lola's jasmine-scented note scribbled in 1928, bearing a signature sample and the 23:54 meeting time (+1 Charm when confronting Zóra).
item.rezkulcs_1928.name: Brass Vent Key
item.rezkulcs_1928.description: A heavy, oil-stained brass key from 1928 for the cellar vent and old storage room. Hide it in the wall and it will still be waiting half a century later.
item.hangvilla_kulcs.name: 1928 Tuning-Fork Key
item.hangvilla_kulcs.description: A two-pronged, faintly humming brass watchmaker's tuning fork from 1928, engraved with 54 (+1 Wits at the workshop puzzle box and before the Time Vault).
node.n001_erkezes_palota.title: Neon Rain Outside Kálmán Palace
node.n001_erkezes_palota.text:
November 11, 2029, 23:10. Sour, lukewarm neon rain patters against the Art Nouveau facade off the Grand Boulevard. Even the gilded date above Kálmán Palace's dark marble gate gleams with smug irony, as if it knows someone is about to have a terrible night inside.

In your coat pocket sits Zóra Kálmán's invitation for a 'strictly discreet, high-paying' affair. At the main gate an overzealous drone terminal hums, while beside the dumpsters a rusted service door sits half-unlatched.
choice.c_n001_fokapu: Stroll through the front gate and flash your finest smile at the camera
choice.c_n001_szerviz: Slip through the rusted service door before anyone logs your arrival
node.n002_elocsarnok_potyi.title: Meeting Pötyi, the Passive-Aggressive AI
node.n002_elocsarnok_potyi.text:
Cold cyan light washes over the marble lobby, and a feminine voice chimes from the ceiling with the tone of someone ready to both serve you tea and file a police report: 'Good evening. I am P-07, affectionately Pötyi, security AI of Kálmán Palace. How delightful that you arrived — though your soles are wet and your pulse is mildly suspicious.'

Beyond the inner doors, champagne chatter drifts from the VIP gallery. Handle Pötyi right and she might actually prove useful tonight.
choice.c_n002_potyi_bokat: Flatter Pötyi as if addressing the mistress of an aristocratic salon
choice.c_n002_potyi_szenzor: Study the blind spots of the lobby's laser sensors while she monologues
choice.c_n002_potyi_tovabb: Wave off the voice and head straight into the gallery
node.n003_szerviz_folyoso.title: A Draft Behind the Wallpaper
node.n003_szerviz_folyoso.text:
The narrow service passage smells of century-old dust and rusted pneumatic tubes. Creeping along the wall behind the gallery, you spot something missing from every official blueprint: a man-wide maintenance gap between the wood paneling and old brick, leaving a half-meter blind spot behind the wall mirror.

Through a tiny wooden hatch you slip unnoticed behind the gallery bar — and even snag a glass of champagne on your way out.
choice.c_n003_galeriaba: Sip the champagne and mingle with the gallery guests
node.n004_aukcio_terem.title: The Illicit Auction Salon
node.n004_aukcio_terem.text:
Dim light, overpriced perfume, and hushed giggles fill the third-floor salon. In the central glass display rests only an empty velvet cushion — the Kálmán Chronometer stays locked upstairs in the Watch Room until midnight, when bidding opens.

It is 23:25. You still have time to sniff around before midnight strikes.
choice.c_n004_zora: Say hello to Zóra Kálmán by the bar
choice.c_n004_maszkos: Question the Masked Bidder lurking in the corner
choice.c_n004_kurator: Approach the sweating, panicked curator, Dr. Fenyves
choice.c_n004_ejfel: Wait near the staircase for the midnight unveiling
node.n005_zora_pezsgo.title: Zóra Kálmán and the Ice-Cold Smile
node.n005_zora_pezsgo.text:
Zóra Kálmán stands barefoot on a tiger-print rug in emerald silk, holding two glasses of vintage rosé. She sizes you up as though deciding whether it's more fun to take you to bed or just shoot you.

'Glad you made it,' she purrs, leaning an inch from your face. 'That old curator looks ready to wet himself, even though the watch stays locked in the Watch Room until midnight. Every fifty years on this exact night it vanishes. If it grows legs again tonight, I won't call the cops — I'll call you. Assuming you can handle the heat.'
choice.c_n005_flort: Fire back a cheeky flirt and press her about the century-old family rumor
choice.c_n005_vissza: Clink glasses and wander back into the salon
node.n006_maszkos_licitalo.title: The Masked Bidder's Whisper
node.n006_maszkos_licitalo.text:
In the darkest corner stands a figure in an antique Venetian brass mask, a heavy gold signet ring on one finger. They don't even turn when you step beside them, yet their raspy, strangely familiar voice cuts right through the music:

'Don't watch the door when the lights go out. In this house, time doesn't run forward — it loops like a watch hand. And if someone winds the mechanism at 23:54, midnight never arrives.' Before you can ask more, two overcaffeinated crypto brokers shove between you, and the figure vanishes into the crowd.
choice.c_n006_vissza: Note the '23:54' remark and return to the center of the salon
node.n007_kurator_ideges.title: Dr. Fenyves's Sweating Brow
node.n007_kurator_ideges.text:
Dr. Fenyves, the auction curator, is already shredding his third paper tissue. When you ask about the Watch Room's security, he nearly chokes on his tonic.

'Everything is hermetically sealed!' he whispers frantically. 'Biometric lock on the fourth-floor Watch Room door, iron bars on the window, laser grid in the hall, and Pötyi's camera watching the mirror inside. Nobody can get in or out! Still… twenty minutes ago I swore I heard an old wall clock ticking through the wall, and there isn't even a working clock up there. Just a dead decorative one frozen for fifty years…'
choice.c_n007_nyugtat: Press him for the exact time and the camera's blind spot
choice.c_n007_vissza: Pat his shoulder and leave him flailing
node.n008_ejfeli_aramszunet.title: Midnight Blackout and a Heavy Thud
node.n008_ejfeli_aramszunet.text:
At precisely 23:54 — not midnight! — every chandelier in the palace flickers as if someone yanked the entire district's power grid with a giant magnet. Over the guests' shrieks, a dull thud echoes from the fourth floor, followed by the groan of an ancient iron-grille elevator chain.

Zóra swears and shoves a billionaire aside: 'To the Watch Room! Now!' Under the red emergency lamps you're first on the stairs — until someone sprinting downward slams right into your shoulder in the dark!
choice.c_n008_elkap: Lunge into the dark and try to grab the fleeing shadow
choice.c_n008_felrohansz: Sidestep them and sprint straight up to the fourth floor
node.n009_orasoba_ajto.title: The Watch Room Bolted from Inside
node.n009_orasoba_ajto.text:
At the end of the fourth-floor corridor, a red security LED blinks above the heavy oak door. Fenyves is already on his knees, twisting his master key in vain: the door is bolted from the inside, the window bars are intact, and Pötyi has engaged an emergency lockdown.

'Nobody could have gotten in!' the curator whimpers. 'Then why is there blood seeping under the threshold?!'
choice.c_n009_potyi_beenged: Ask Pötyi nicely — remembering your charm, she immediately releases the lock
choice.c_n009_zarfeltor: Short-circuit the emergency panel with a strip of metal
choice.c_n009_berug: Charge and shoulder-ram the emergency latch before Zóra arrives
node.n010_orasoba_helyszin.title: Shattered Display and the Broken Watch Chain
node.n010_orasoba_helyszin.text:
Inside, the air reeks of ozone, cheap cologne, and fresh blood. The window is untouched and the inner deadbolt is still thrown, yet the central display case lies in shards, a guard is out cold with a split brow on the rug, and the Kálmán Chronometer is gone.

Beside the velvet cushion you spot a warm, tingling snippet of gold links — the Broken Watch Chain. You pocket it before anyone else sees, then scan the locked room. Three clues scream for attention before you make your deduction.
choice.c_n010_pohar: Examine the two champagne glasses left on the side table
choice.c_n010_vernyom: Follow the blood drops and boot print on the rug
choice.c_n010_faliora: Inspect the decorative grandfather clock frozen on the wall for fifty years
choice.c_n010_megfejtes: You have enough — solve the locked-room paradox
node.n011_nyom_pezsgospohar.title: Lipstick and a Twenty-Minute Lie
node.n011_nyom_pezsgospohar.text:
Of the two glasses on the side table, one is half-full and completely flat — poured at least half an hour ago. The other is still ice-cold with crisp bubbles, bearing not lipstick on its rim, but a smudge of dark, resin-scented sealing wax.

At most six minutes passed between the thud and your arrival, and Pötyi's camera watched the center of the room until 23:54 — when the system went dark for six minutes.
choice.c_n011_vissza: Note the timing gap on the glasses and step back to the center of the room
node.n012_nyom_vernyom.title: Boot Prints Leading Into Nothing
node.n012_nyom_vernyom.text:
Beside the knocked-out guard, two drops of blood point toward the display case, while a fresh boot print dusted with white lime plaster stops dead at the inner wall farthest from the door.

The air vent is far too narrow for an adult, and its screws are rusted shut. Yet beneath one gilded strip of wall molding, freshly chipped plaster dust glints under the emergency lamp.
choice.c_n012_vissza: Take note of the plaster dust along the wall and keep looking
node.n013_nyom_fali_ora.title: The Grandfather Clock Stopped at 23:54
node.n013_nyom_fali_ora.text:
Against the middle of the wall stands a two-meter carved mahogany grandfather clock whose mechanism has supposedly been dead for fifty years. As you lean in, the Broken Watch Chain in your palm grows warm — and the clock's hands aren't stuck at midnight, but at precisely 23:54.

A tiny keyhole hides along the side of the casing, and the carpet fibers beneath it are pressed into a neat semicircle, as if the entire mahogany cabinet swung outward on a hidden hinge.
choice.c_n013_vissza: No ordinary decorative clock… turn back toward the room
node.n014_rejtv1_paradoxon.title: Logic Puzzle 1: The Locked-Room Paradox
node.n014_rejtv1_paradoxon.text: Zóra and Fenyves are already arguing in the doorway while Pötyi's system reboots — in five seconds the room seals up for good. You have one shot to call how the thief vanished from the locked Watch Room at 23:54!
choice.c_n014_valasz_helyes: "Behind the mahogany wall clock is a pivoting service gap — they slipped out at 23:54!"
choice.c_n014_valasz_rossz_ablak: "They leaped out the barred window onto a drone and bolted the bars back behind them!"
choice.c_n014_valasz_rossz_or: "The knocked-out guard stole the watch himself and swallowed it!"
choice.c_n014_valasz_rossz_szellozo: "They squeezed down a twenty-centimeter air vent and screwed it shut from inside!"
node.n015_rejtv1_siker.title: Click of the Mahogany Cabinet
node.n015_rejtv1_siker.text:
Before Zóra's mocking laugh even fades, you briskly twist the dead clock's hands from 23:54 to midnight. A metallic click echoes inside the wall, and the entire two-meter mahogany cabinet swings smoothly open.

Behind it sits a cramped copper-lined alcove housing a three-dial Time Vault (engraved 1928 / 1979 / 2029) and a shimmering blue-gold vortex tugging hard at the Broken Watch Chain. Zóra's jaw drops as you dive inside and pull the clock shut behind you.
choice.c_n015_tovabb: Touch the cold copper frame of the Time Vault with the Broken Watch Chain
node.n016_rejtv1_kudarc.title: Zóra's Slap and a Lucky Stumble
node.n016_rejtv1_kudarc.text:
Zóra stares at you for one beat, then delivers a slap so crisp and brutal you stagger straight into the towering mahogany wall clock (-2 HP).

'Enough of the idiot theories!' she hisses — until your weight triggers a hidden latch and the grandfather clock swings wide open! Inside waits a copper alcove, a three-dial Time Vault, and a glowing vortex calling to the Watch Chain in your pocket. You don't think twice: you leap in and slam the clock in Zóra's face.
choice.c_n016_tovabb: Grab the Time Vault's mysterious handle inside the vortex
node.n017_elso_idougras.title: Falling Through a Century
node.n017_elso_idougras.text:
The Broken Watch Chain flares blue in your palm, and the alcove floor drops out from under your boots. Neon signs, boxy 1970s Trabant headlights, and 1920s gas lamps strobe past you like film reels spinning backward, drowned out by deafening clockwork ticking.

Everything hinges on keeping your head together inside the vortex (the Broken Watch Chain grants +1 Nerve).
choice.c_n017_ugras: Grip the chain tight and dive into the lowest archway of light
node.n018_erkezes_1928.title: Budapest, 1928: The Black Cockatoo
node.n018_erkezes_1928.text:
You hit damp cobblestones in a narrow alley, immediately slapped by the unmistakable bouquet of coal smoke, cheap cologne, and fresh horse manure. Above your head a gas lamp hisses, and beside a cellar stairway swings a bold painted sign: 'FEKETE KAKADU – NIGHT CABARET'.

Hot jazz, popping champagne corks, and raucous laughter spill up from below. The Broken Watch Chain is still warm in your pocket — you are one century earlier, at the exact same palace, on the night of the very first heist.
choice.c_n018_belep_kakaduba: Straighten your collar and head down the steps of the Black Cockatoo
node.n019_kakadu_bejarat.title: Feri Kőműves and the Silk Curtain
node.n019_kakadu_bejarat.text:
In front of the Black Cockatoo's red velvet curtain leans a wardrobe-sized bouncer with a waxed handlebar mustache, Feri Kőműves. As he eyes your jacket cut a century out of date, his eyebrows rise as if greeting a lost Martian.

'Good evening, guv'nor — or milady,' he rumbles, cracking his knuckles. 'Private affair tonight: only guests with invitations drink Oszkár Kálmán's champagne. Though there's always the dark coal chute out back if you're chilly.'
choice.c_n019_bloff: Flash a cheeky grin and bluff that you are Oszkár Kálmán's trusted guest
choice.c_n019_piazas: Lock eyes with Feri and down a shot of his suspicious homemade plum brandy
choice.c_n019_oldalajto: Don't argue with his fists — slip around the building toward the back alley
node.n020_kakadu_pult.title: The Smoky Whirl of the Black Cockatoo
node.n020_kakadu_pult.text:
Inside, golden cigar smoke drifts under crystal chandeliers, a brass sextet tears into a Charleston on the small stage, and silk-stockinged flappers laugh beside monocled bankers. The wall clock behind the bar reads precisely 23:10 — fifty minutes until the fatal shot rings out upstairs, or so everyone will think.

Three trails beckon through the club: perfume and raised voices drift from Red Lola's dressing room, clinking glasses echo from Baron Székely's card room, and a silent apprentice watches by the boiler-room stairs. Or you can catch your breath at the bar before midnight.
choice.c_n020_lola: Slip backstage toward Red Lola's dressing room
choice.c_n020_szekely: Part the velvet curtain into Baron Székely's private card room
choice.c_n020_pince: Follow the silent apprentice down the cellar boiler-room stairs
choice.c_n020_barpult: Take a breather at the bar for a glass of Tokaji and a black coffee
choice.c_n020_ejfel: The 23:45 finale is near — take a spot near the stage to watch midnight unfold
node.n021_hatso_sikator.title: Coal Chute and Cellar Steps
node.n021_hatso_sikator.text:
In the back alley two stray cats duel over a herring head beside an open kitchen coal chute and a rusted iron door. From inside drifts a waiter's cursing and the hiss of soda siphons.

A starched white waiter's apron hangs right on the hook — slip inside cleanly and nobody by the bar will ask for an invitation.
choice.c_n021_lopakodas: Snatch the waiter's apron and glide silently into the cabaret
choice.c_n021_beoson: Wait until the waiter turns his back and walk straight into the bar
node.n022_lola_oltozo_elott.title: Jasmine Perfume and a Slamming Door
node.n022_lola_oltozo_elott.text:
Down the narrow backstage corridor, a hoarse, furious shout echoes off the tiles: 'Mention the inheritance one more time, Oszkár, and I'll rip that mustache off myself!'

A flustered waiter rushes past you with an ice bucket of champagne, while a bored stagehand props up the door outside Lola's dressing room. Without style, you'll have to loop around through the prop hall.
choice.c_n022_sarm: Turn on your finest charm and tell the stagehand Lola is expecting an urgent telegram
choice.c_n022_kopog: Circle through the prop room instead, maybe catching a look at the waiter's ledger
node.n023_lola_oltozoje.title: Before Red Lola's Mirror
node.n023_lola_oltozoje.text:
Lola 'Red' Várady turns from her bulb-lit vanity in a crimson silk kimono, powder brush in hand. There is enough smoke and irony in her eyes to eat two Budapest journalists for breakfast.

'Finally someone without a monocle,' she purrs, exhaling a ribbon of cigarette smoke. 'If you came for Oszkár, you're late: we popped his first champagne upstairs in the Watch Room at 23:15, fought over that cursed three-dial pocket watch, and I walked out at 23:30. In fifteen minutes — from 23:45 to midnight — I'm singing onstage in front of two hundred drunks. Look at this perfumed note on my table — what is that old lecher up to?'
choice.c_n023_meggyoz: Warn Lola straight up that someone plans to pin tonight's murder on her
choice.c_n023_elemez: Inspect the signature on the note and the champagne tab lying beside it
choice.c_n023_elcsen: While she reaches for her lipstick, pocket the Perfumed Letter and slip back out
node.n024_lola_kulissza.title: The Waiter's Ledger in the Prop Room
node.n024_lola_kulissza.text:
Among feathered boas and painted flats sits the head waiter's open beverage ledger. Under tonight's date, three entries are billed to Oszkár Kálmán's fourth-floor Watch Room: three bottles of 1921 French champagne — one sent up at 23:15, one requested beside the hearth ahead of time, and a third ordered by Baron Székely for 23:50.

Three bottles for one hour is steep even for a magnate. Before anyone spots you, you knock and step into Lola's dressing room.
choice.c_n024_belep: Memorize the three champagne entries and step through Lola's door
node.n025_lola_szovetseg.title: Before the Midnight Number
node.n025_lola_szovetseg.text:
The jasmine-scented Perfumed Letter rests safely in your pocket as Lola tugs on her crimson silk gloves. The stage manager is already fidgeting in the doorway: five minutes to showtime.

'Listen up,' she winks over her shoulder. 'From 23:45 straight through midnight I'm standing under the spotlight. My hands are clean — and if they go hunting for a scapegoat upstairs, we'll cross paths on the stairs.'
choice.c_n025_vissza: Nod and head back out into the Black Cockatoo's main hall
node.n026_szekely_kartyaszoba.title: Baron Székely's Green Felt
node.n026_szekely_kartyaszoba.text:
In the dimness behind the velvet drape, Baron Artúr Székely — Oszkár Kálmán's cynical lawyer and card partner — sprawls across the green baize. Beside his gilded silver cigarette case sit an empty ice bucket and a freshly drafted power of attorney.

'Another fortune hunter?' the Baron drawls, riffling French playing cards. 'Sit for a hand of poker since you barged in. Say, in ten minutes I have to pop upstairs anyway to witness a tiny codicil to a will.'
choice.c_n026_poker: Call a reckless raise and watch his eyes for a tell
choice.c_n026_kifigyel: Study the notepad by his elbow and every glance he steals at his watch
choice.c_n026_ellop: While he reaches for his glass, lift a slip of paper beside his open wallet
node.n027_poker_gyozelem.title: The Baron's Nervous Glance at the Clock
node.n027_poker_gyozelem.text:
Székely's lip twitches as you lay down your hand — or as you read the receipt reflected in the wall mirror. Székely plans to go up to the Watch Room at 23:45, and he explicitly instructed the waiter to keep two more bottles upstairs: one chilled for delivery at 23:50, and another already warming on the side table by the hearth.

'Enough of this game,' he snaps coldly, pushing back his chair. 'Meet me upstairs over champagne in fifteen minutes, if you have the stomach.'
choice.c_n027_kovet: Pocket the details of the two bottles and note Székely's 23:45 departure
node.n028_poker_bukas.title: Shown Out of the Card Room
node.n028_poker_bukas.text:
Baron Székely chuckles thinly, and his two bodyguards escort you through the velvet curtain firmly enough to bruise your ribs for two minutes. Even so, through the closing door you catch him checking his watch:

'I'm heading up to Oszkár at 23:45. Tell the boy the iced champagne had better be at the door at 23:50 sharp — and leave the midnight toast to me.'
choice.c_n028_osszeszed: Brush off your coat and note Székely's 23:45 schedule
node.n029_szekely_nyom.title: A Lawyer's Too-Neat Alibi
node.n029_szekely_nyom.text: Standing outside the card room, the first suspicious piece clicks into place: Baron Székely vanishes from sight for over ten minutes starting at 23:45, right while Lola is singing onstage — yet for some reason he ordered an iced champagne for 23:50. If there's murder tonight, that timetable stinks.
choice.c_n029_vissza: Step back into the bustle of the main hall
node.n030_kazanhaz_lejaro.title: The Silent Clockmaker's Apprentice
node.n030_kazanhaz_lejaro.text:
Coal dust, machine oil, and hot copper hang thick in the cellar boiler room. Beside the throbbing furnace stands a slim youth in a grease-stained apron — holding a heavy brass key, with an unmistakably familiar gold signet ring glinting on his left index finger. Identical to the one worn by the 2029 Masked Bidder.

Without uttering a word, the boy presses the Brass Vent Key into your palm, then points at two things in the gloom: a loose brick chalked with '79' beside the storage grate, and a narrow dumbwaiter shaft running straight up.
choice.c_n030_kulcs_eltesz: Take the Brass Vent Key and follow where the apprentice points
node.n031_inas_alkuja.title: Two Quiet Twists in the Timeline
node.n031_inas_alkuja.text: The boiler-room clock reads 23:40. The Clockmaker's Apprentice waits silently to see what you do with the chalked brick and the dumbwaiter shaft rising upstairs. Hide the key here in 1928 and it may still wait half a century later; climb the dumbwaiter and you can reach the Chronometer upstairs before the shot.
choice.c_n031_elrejt_kulcs: Pry out the chalked brick and hide the Brass Vent Key behind it for 1979
choice.c_n031_etellift: Haul yourself up the narrow dumbwaiter rope to the fourth-floor Watch Room wall
choice.c_n031_vissza: Nod farewell to the apprentice and return to the Black Cockatoo bar
node.n032_falba_rejtett_kulcs.title: A Message Fifty Years Ahead
node.n032_falba_rejtett_kulcs.text:
Behind the loose brick lies a dry, soot-blackened hollow. You tuck the Brass Vent Key inside and slide the brick neatly back into place. The apprentice gives a single nod — as though he knows a sunflower-seed-chewing bartender or you yourself will need it half a century from now.

Your fingers are dusty, but you just planted a tiny insurance policy in the past.
choice.c_n032_vissza_kazan: Brush the brick dust off your sleeves and turn back to the boiler room
node.n033_ora_megkarcolasa.title: Through the Dumbwaiter Slit: The Chronometer
node.n033_ora_megkarcolasa.text:
At 23:42 you crack the wooden dumbwaiter hatch a single centimeter on the fourth floor. The Watch Room is still empty! On the mahogany desk rests the gold-and-obsidian Kálmán Chronometer untouched, while on the hearth nearby an unopened, suspiciously wired champagne bottle warms right beside the glowing coals.

Reach out with a steel tack and you can scratch a tiny X onto the Chronometer's caseback — so you'll spot the real watch instantly among fakes in 1979. Just don't make a sound!
choice.c_n033_karcol_ugyesseg: With surgeon-quick precision, scratch a tiny X into the Chronometer's caseback
choice.c_n033_karcol_idegek: Hold your breath and reach through the dark slit with rock-steady hands
choice.c_n033_csak_figyel: Don't risk it — just note the bottle warming by the hearth and slide back down
node.n034_kakadu_bar_piheno.title: 1919 Tokaji Aszú and Black Espresso
node.n034_kakadu_bar_piheno.text:
Beside a warm towel, the bartender slides you two fingers of 1919 Tokaji aszú and a cup of thick, rocket-fuel espresso. Two minutes ago the 1928 night still ached in your ribs, but the sweet wine and bitter coffee steady your pounding temples (+3 HP).

Down the bar, two waiters whisper that Red Lola takes the stage at 23:45 sharp, and her midnight finale rattles every chandelier in the cellar.
choice.c_n034_gyogyul: Finish the coffee and head back toward the main floor refreshed
node.n035_ejfeli_loves_1928.title: 23:54: A Flicker, Then the Midnight Bang
node.n035_ejfeli_loves_1928.text:
At 23:45 Red Lola steps into the spotlight and holds the entire cabaret spellbound. At precisely 23:54 — as the brass section hits its loudest fortissimo — every chandelier shivers for one eerie beat, as though an invisible vortex just yawned open inside the house.

At 23:58 Baron Székely strolls down the staircase in immaculate tails and loudly winks at a judge by the bar. Then at midnight sharp — 00:00 — a deafening bang explodes from the fourth floor, cutting Lola's high note dead!
choice.c_n035_elore_fut: Vault the overturned chairs and sprint upstairs ahead of everyone
choice.c_n035_szekely_mellett: Stick close behind Székely as you rush up, watching his every flinch
node.n036_orasoba_1928_helyszin.title: Gunsmoke and Champagne Shards in the Watch Room
node.n036_orasoba_1928_helyszin.text:
When you burst into the fourth-floor Watch Room, acrid smoke hangs over sweet spilled champagne. Oszkár Kálmán lies slumped across the mahogany desk — shot dead through the heart, with the Kálmán Chronometer once again gone.

The Baron clutches his chest dramatically: 'Monstrous! Why, the shot rang out at midnight sharp, when I had already been downstairs with the Judge for two whole minutes!' Three glaring details beg for inspection before Székely walks free — or takes the fall.
choice.c_n036_holttest: Examine Oszkár Kálmán's body, the pillow, and his pocket watch
choice.c_n036_uvegek: Count and touch the three champagne bottles scattered in the room
choice.c_n036_kandallo: Check the glowing hearth and the tall mahogany clock along the wall
choice.c_n036_megfejtes: You have every piece — expose the midnight trick
node.n037_nyom_zsebora_2354.title: The Pocket Watch Crushed at 23:54
node.n037_nyom_zsebora_2354.text:
Tucked in Oszkár Kálmán's waistcoat sits a plain silver pocket watch whose crystal was shattered by the fatal bullet. Its bent hands point to precisely 23:54. There are no powder burns around his wound — yet on the sofa lies an ornate velvet cushion scorched black around a bullet hole, used to muffle the real shot.

Which means at 23:54, under the roaring brass finale downstairs, nobody heard the silenced pistol.
choice.c_n037_vissza: Note the 23:54 pocket watch and bullet-pierced pillow, then keep looking
node.n038_nyom_harom_uveg.title: A Tale of Three Champagne Bottles
node.n038_nyom_harom_uveg.text:
Three champagne bottles tell the story, matching the waiter's ledger. Bottle I sits warm and half-poured beside the sofa (opened by Lola and Oszkár at 23:15). Bottle II rests unopened in an untouched ice bucket by the door (delivered at 23:50).

Bottle III, however, has blown into a thousand green shards on the hearthstone — leaving curled gold foil and a twisted copper wire, with zero bullet holes in the wall or ceiling.
choice.c_n038_vissza: Compare the temperature and state of all three bottles and step back
node.n039_nyom_kandallo_ora.title: Wired Coals and Sooty Hinges
node.n039_nyom_kandallo_ora.text:
Beside the hearth's glowing coals reeks a singed loop of copper wire and burnt fuse cord — someone rigged the sealed champagne bottle close to the heat so rising pressure would blow it like a cannon shot right around midnight.

And a few paces away, the brand-new mahogany grandfather clock already stands frozen at 23:54 even in 1928, with fresh soot smudged across its hinge. Someone just slipped out through that hidden copper alcove!
choice.c_n039_lola_sugo: Lola murmurs quietly behind you: 'Székely came downstairs at 23:58, well before the bang!'
choice.c_n039_vissza: Store the image of the scorched copper rig in your mind and turn back
node.n040_rejtv2_pezsgo_ora.title: Logic Puzzle 2: Three Champagne Bottles and the 23:54 Watch
node.n040_rejtv2_pezsgo_ora.text:
Guests crowd the doorway while Baron Székely taps his watch smugly, insisting he was downstairs with the Judge from 23:58 onward and couldn't have fired at midnight.

Recall the facts: Lola sang onstage from 23:45 to 00:00; Bottle I has been warm and half-full since 23:15; Bottle II sits unopened in 23:50 ice; Bottle III exploded beside the glowing hearth; and Oszkár's pocket watch stopped at 23:54 beside a scorched pillow. What actually happened tonight?
choice.c_n040_helyes: "Székely shot Oszkár through the pillow at 23:54 under the brass music, and rigged Bottle III on the coals to explode at 00:00 as a fake alibi!"
choice.c_n040_rossz_lola: "Red Lola poisoned Bottle I at 23:15, and Oszkár conveniently waited until midnight to collapse!"
choice.c_n040_rossz_inas: "The apprentice hid a bomb inside the unopened, iced Bottle II to kill Oszkár at midnight!"
choice.c_n040_rossz_ongyilkos: "Oszkár shot himself at 23:54 for insurance fraud, and at midnight we heard his ghost!"
node.n041_rejtv2_siker.title: The Baron Exposed and the 54 Tuning Fork
node.n041_rejtv2_siker.text:
Székely drains white as the Judge and two burly waiters block the door. Backpedaling in panic, the Baron drops a two-pronged, faintly humming brass key from his tailcoat — the 1928 Tuning-Fork Key engraved with '54' — as he snarls:

'Damn it all! Yes, I shot the miser at 23:54 — but when I reached into his pocket, the Kálmán Chronometer was already gone! Someone beat me to it one minute before I nudged the bottle!' You snatch up the Tuning-Fork Key and duck into the copper alcove behind the swung-open grandfather clock.
choice.c_n041_idokapu: Strike the Tuning-Fork Key against the Time Vault's 1979 dial
node.n042_rejtv2_kudarc.title: Silver-Headed Cane and a Dive Into the Alcove
node.n042_rejtv2_kudarc.text:
Székely snorts at your bungled accusation and, before anyone reacts, cracks his silver-headed cane across your ribs hard enough to steal your breath. Sprawled on the rug, you hear him hiss:

'Incompetent fool! I couldn't even find the Chronometer myself when I finished him at 23:54!' He bolts down the corridor, dropping a two-pronged brass Tuning-Fork Key from his pocket just as you scramble toward the copper alcove behind the wall clock.
choice.c_n042_elkap_kulcs: Lunge for the glinting Tuning-Fork Key before the mahogany cabinet shuts behind you
choice.c_n042_bemenekul: Don't risk another blow — hurl yourself straight into the Time Vault's vortex
node.n043_masodik_idougras.title: Fifty Years Forward: 1928 to 1979
node.n043_masodik_idougras.text:
The Broken Watch Chain flares again in your palm, yanking you forward along the stream of time: twenties fedoras, wartime sirens, neon espresso bars, and fifty years of dust swirl around you in a blinding copper spiral.

Someone beat even Székely to the Watch Room by one minute in 1928 — and now you are hurtling straight toward the 1979 dial. Hold your nerve, or time the beat of the impact!
choice.c_n043_idegek: Grit your teeth and rely on sheer Nerve to burst through the 1979 gate
choice.c_n043_esz: Count the ticking cadence and step out cleanly at the 1979 resonance point
node.n044_erkezes_1979.title: Budapest, 1979: Black-Market Blues and Sunflower Shells
node.n044_erkezes_1979.text:
You land on a worn faux-leather sofa at the bottom of a dim Budapest cellar lit by a rotating disco ball. The air smells of Traubisoda, Symphonia cigarettes, and smuggled Western denim while a scratchy pop hit warbles from the speakers.

From behind the bar leans a gold-toothed guy in a tracksuit jacket, cracking sunflower seeds: 'Well hey there, boss! Didn't take the stairs, huh? Welcome to November 11, 1979. I'm Sunflower Béla — and if that cursed gold watch doesn't vanish off the fourth floor again tonight, I'll eat my Trabant's license plate!'
node.d1_kifogyott_az_ido.title: Out of Time
node.d1_kifogyott_az_ido.text: One blow, fall, or temporal shock too many finally drains the last of your strength. Somewhere between the three eras of Kálmán Palace the ticking stops — and your name becomes just another unsolved footnote in a century-old police dossier.
choice.c_n044_bela_pinceje: Brush the 1928 dust off your coat and step into Sunflower Béla's smoky cellar
node.n045_bela_pinceklub.title: Sunflower Shells and Smuggled Denim at the Bar
node.n045_bela_pinceklub.text:
Sunflower Béla absently wipes an empty Traubisoda bottle while sizing up your battered clothes. In the corner two leather-jacketed men argue softly over a blue diplomatic briefcase, and smoke hangs thick over the dance floor.

'Listen, pal,' Béla leans closer, dropping formalities. 'Tonight something big is going down on the fourth floor with that old watch, and down here Ilona Kardos's booth listens to everyone. Unless you're a cop — though honestly you look like you fell out of a time machine — tell me where we stand.'
choice.c_n045_bela_sarm: Flash a cheeky grin and offer to solve one of his headaches upstairs
choice.c_n045_bela_idegek: Lay the Broken Watch Chain on the bar without blinking to show you mean business
choice.c_n045_tovabb: Wink at Béla and wander off to scout the cellar club yourself
node.n046_1979_hub.title: November 11, 1979, 23:10: Black-Market Underworld
node.n046_1979_hub.text:
The cellar club clock reads 23:10 — forty-four minutes until 23:54. On one side of the bar a heavy iron door guards Béla's black-market storeroom; across the hall Kardos Ilona's listening booth hides behind tinted glass; and down the back corridor ticks a dusty watchmaker's workshop.

Meanwhile, Western smugglers are already gathering on the fourth floor for an illicit midnight watch auction. Where do you start?
choice.c_n046_bela: Inspect Béla's currency storeroom and the old 1928 vent wall
choice.c_n046_ilona: Knock on the door of Ilona Kardos's listening booth
choice.c_n046_muhely: Head down the back corridor to the old cellar watchmaker's workshop
choice.c_n046_piheno: Grab a cold spritzer and a sandwich at Béla's bar
choice.c_n046_aukcio: The smuggler auction is starting soon — head up to the fourth floor
node.n047_bela_valutazo.title: The Padlocked Storeroom and Brick 79
node.n047_bela_valutazo.text:
In Béla's back hall, bales of Western denim, copied blue passports, and Deutsche Mark tins line up beside a rusted ventilation grate. A chunky brass padlock secures the storeroom door — the exact kind matched by a certain key from 1928.

Beside it on the brick wall, the faint chalk outline of the number 79 from fifty years ago is still visible.
choice.c_n047_tegla: Pry loose Brick 79 — the Brass Vent Key you hid in 1928 is waiting right there!
choice.c_n047_feltor: Attack the stiff brass padlock with a piece of wire
choice.c_n047_bela_segit: Call Béla over; as an ally, he tosses you his heavy crowbar
choice.c_n047_vissza: Leave the storeroom alone and head back to the club
node.n048_1928_kulcs_megtalalva.title: A Fifty-Year Butterfly Effect
node.n048_1928_kulcs_megtalalva.text: The brick slides easily from the dust, revealing the Brass Vent Key gleaming exactly where you left it fifty years ago. With one silent turn, the old storeroom padlock clicks open before anyone hears a thing.
node.n049_lomtar_belso.title: The Rooftop Blueprint and a Hidden Son
node.n049_lomtar_belso.text:
On a musty shelf beside yellowed 1928 birth records lies a neatly rolled Smuggler's Blueprint marking the Kálmán Palace's rooftop service ladders and secret passages. You pocket it!

On the margin of one folder, a handwritten note catches your eye: 'Oszkár Kálmán's concealed son, Ádám Kálmán — kept on the palace grounds since 1928.' Suddenly boots thunder down the stairs outside and police sirens wail!
choice.c_n049_kimegy: Roll up the blueprint and peek into the corridor
node.n050_bela_lebukas_veszely.title: Police Raid in the Cellar!
node.n050_bela_lebukas_veszely.text: 'Police! Hands against the wall!' bellows an overeager lieutenant from the top of the stairs while Béla kills the disco ball and kicks his cash suitcase under a rug. Two uniformed officers sweep their flashlights straight toward your corridor!
choice.c_n050_razzia_szerencse: Trust blind Luck and duck behind a laundry basket and denim bales
choice.c_n050_razzia_bloff: Step out calmly and bluff that you are a municipal fire inspector
node.n051_bela_hatso_szoba.title: Cost of a Forced Lock
node.n051_bela_hatso_szoba.text: The rusted padlock snaps back against your thumb before finally giving way with a loud clatter. Inside you grab the Smuggler's Blueprint pinned to the wall — just as the noise brings a police raid thundering down the stairs!
choice.c_n051_tovabb: Stuff the blueprint into your coat and check the stairs
node.n052_razzia_meguszva.title: Red Tape Greased with Denim
node.n052_razzia_meguszva.text: With a carton of Western chewing gum and a fat envelope, Béla smooths over the 'misunderstanding' in minutes. Soon the officers move on to raid the espresso bar next door, leaving you richer by one secret rooftop blueprint.
choice.c_n052_vissza: Brush off the dust and return to the 1979 club hub
node.n053_ilona_lehallgato.title: Ilona Kardos and the Two-Way Mirror
node.n053_ilona_lehallgato.text:
Behind tinted glass, wrapped in blue cigarette smoke, Ilona Kardos sits between two spinning reel-to-reel tape decks. Her razor-sharp gaze and cool smile say she plays both Western buyers and Budapest state security with equal ease.

'Good evening,' she purrs over the microphone. 'If you want the tape from upstairs, bad news: everyone lies tonight, even magnetic tape. What are you offering for what's spinning on this reel?'
choice.c_n053_flort: Play the 1928 scandal angle and offer a charming, equal-terms bargain
choice.c_n053_esz: Point out the splice marks on the reel to show you know wiretap craft
choice.c_n053_elcsen: When she reaches for a dial, snatch the Spy Reel Tape straight off the deck
node.n054_ilona_alku.title: Two Agents at One Table
node.n054_ilona_alku.text: Ilona raises an appreciative eyebrow and clicks off the left-hand deck. 'Clever. Take the heat off the seller at midnight's auction, and I'll help you trace where the real watch goes at 23:54.' She hands over the Spy Reel Tape.
choice.c_n054_szalag: Take the Spy Reel Tape and examine the reel closely
node.n055_ilona_csapda.title: The Locking Booth Door
node.n055_ilona_csapda.text: Ilona's cool smile freezes as a button under her desk bolts the soundproof door. 'Too bad, darling. Guests aren't supposed to sniff around the channels.' Her hand hovers over an alarm switch — right beside the spinning Spy Reel Tape.
choice.c_n055_kitor: Yank the tape off the spindle and shoulder-ram the bolted door
choice.c_n055_kicsuszik: Pocket the tape and slip out through the service hatch beside the air grate
node.n056_szalag_megszerezve.title: Three Splice Strips on Brown Tape
node.n056_szalag_megszerezve.text: Held up to the bulb, the Spy Reel Tape shows three places where the magnetic ribbon was cut and spliced with clear tape. Its box label claims an uncut recording of the Watch Room from 23:50 to midnight — already looking mighty suspicious.
choice.c_n056_tovabb: Pocket the reel for the midnight playback
node.n057_ilona_bucsuszava.title: Stepping Out from Behind the Mirror
node.n057_ilona_bucsuszava.text: Ilona catches your eye one last time through the cracked door: 'Don't trust the smugglers' watch at the auction. There isn't a single genuine piece in the salon tonight — or if there is, it isn't the one they're bidding on.'
choice.c_n057_vissza: Nod and head back to the 1979 hub
node.n058_orasmuhely_1979.title: The Old Cellar Watchmaker and the Gold Signet
node.n058_orasmuhely_1979.text:
Where the old boiler room stood in 1928, a cramped watchmaker's workshop now ticks with a thousand pocket watches under a yellow desk lamp. A lean, gray-haired craftsman bends over a loupe — and on his left index finger gleams the exact heavy gold signet ring you saw on the 1928 apprentice and the 2029 Masked Bidder.

He shows zero surprise. He slides over a tiny vial of faintly glowing Watchmaker's Phosphor Dust, then points at two things: a thick security conduit running up toward 2029, and a brass box locked by three gear dials.
choice.c_n058_beszel: Take the Watchmaker's Phosphor Dust and inspect the wall conduit
node.n059_1979_szabotazs.title: Roots of the Future Alarm
node.n059_1979_szabotazs.text: Already in 1979, that thick gray conduit connects the palace's future security hub to the fourth floor. Tweak the delay relay now, and fifty years later an entire security zone will stutter at your command.
choice.c_n059_riaszto_szabotazs: Bridge the delay relay with a fine screwdriver so the 2029 alarm lags behind
choice.c_n059_csak_tovabb: Leave the cables untouched and step up to the workbench
node.n060_muhely_uzenet.title: A Note in the Drawer and the Gear Box
node.n060_muhely_uzenet.text: On the old watchmaker's desk sits an empty steel drawer sealed until 2029 — slip a short note inside now and you might find an answer in the future. Beside it sits a secret brass box guarded by three gear dials (the 1928 Tuning-Fork Key grants +1 Wits here).
choice.c_n060_uzenet_es_doboz: Drop a warning note into the 2029 drawer and inspect the three gear dials
choice.c_n060_doboz_siman: Step straight up to the three-gear box without leaving a note
node.n061_rejtv3_fogaskerek.title: Logic Puzzle 3: The Three Gear Discs
node.n061_rejtv3_fogaskerek.text:
Three gear dials (A, B, C) labeled 1 through 9 crown the brass box, with three rules engraved in the watchmaker's hand:

1. The sum of all three dials is exactly 11.
2. The middle dial B is exactly 2 higher than dial A.
3. Dial A and dial C have the exact same value.

Which combination opens the lock?
choice.c_n061_helyes: Set the dials to A = 3, B = 5, C = 3
choice.c_n061_rossz_1: Set the dials to A = 2, B = 4, C = 5
choice.c_n061_rossz_2: Set the dials to A = 4, B = 6, C = 1
choice.c_n061_rossz_3: Set the dials to A = 3, B = 6, C = 2
node.n062_rejtv3_siker.title: The Second Code Number: 11
node.n062_rejtv3_siker.text: At 3-5-3 the brass lid pops gently open. Inside rests a small brass tag reading '1979 – 11' alongside an engraved monogram: 'Á. K.' The old watchmaker smiles faintly: 'Sharp eyes. You have the 1979 dial number — now go upstairs and check what they're auctioning in place of the real watch.'
choice.c_n062_vissza: Note the number 11 and the monogram, then return to the club
node.n063_rejtv3_kudarc.title: Snapping Steel Spring
node.n063_rejtv3_kudarc.text: As you twist the wrong gears, a steel safety pin snaps sharply across your knuckles (-2 HP). The old watchmaker shakes his head and wraps your hand in a rag: 'The math was kinder than that spring. The 1979 number is 11 anyway — now hurry upstairs before the auction blows up.'
choice.c_n063_vissza: Shake out your bruised hand and head back to the bar
node.n064_bela_froccs_piheno.title: Cold Soda and a Warm Baloney Roll
node.n064_bela_froccs_piheno.text: Béla slides a tall, frosty wine spritzer and two thick baloney rolls across the bar. 'Eat up before you run out of steam! Things are about to get smoky upstairs.' The cold drink and food steady your nerves in no time (+3 HP).
choice.c_n064_vissza: Thank Béla and get back to the investigation
node.n065_csempesz_aukcio.title: The Fourth-Floor Smuggler Auction
node.n065_csempesz_aukcio.text:
At 23:45 in the fourth-floor salon, West German fences, party officials, and Ilona Kardos crowd around a red velvet case. Inside gleams the Kálmán Chronometer — or at least a very expensive lookalike.

Seeing the watch triggers an immediate memory of 1928 and the dumbwaiter shaft.
choice.c_n065_karcolast_nez: Flip the watch over and point out it lacks the tiny X you scratched in 1928!
choice.c_n065_esz_vizsgal: Examine the casing joints and hinge patina to check if it's a forgery
choice.c_n065_kivar: Hang back by the wall and watch as 23:54 approaches
node.n066_hamisitvany_botrany.title: The 23:54 Blackout and the Spliced Tape
node.n066_hamisitvany_botrany.text:
Just as uproar erupts over the fake watch in the display, every light on the floor dies at precisely 23:54! When power returns two minutes later, the inner Watch Room safe stands empty — the real Chronometer has vanished in the dark again!

Ilona hits play on her reel deck with a smug smirk: 'No point arguing, the tape from 23:50 to midnight is completely uncut!' Yet you remember those clear splice strips.
choice.c_n066_elemzes: Compare all four segments of the tape and pinpoint the forged two minutes
node.n067_rejtv4_szalag.title: Logic Puzzle 4: The Spliced Reel Tape
node.n067_rejtv4_szalag.text:
The tape covers four two-minute segments from 23:52 to midnight, but one segment was spliced in from elsewhere to cover for the real thief:

• Segment A (23:52–23:54): footsteps in the hall, a distant clink, and a sharp 50 Hz power hum cutting off at the end.
• Segment B (23:54–23:56): dead silence with zero blackout buzz, and in the middle the exact same Route 4 streetcar bell rings twice in a row.
• Segment C (23:56–23:58): frantic whispers, shattering glass, and a distant siren along the Grand Boulevard.
• Segment D (23:58–00:00): heavy door slam, shouting, and a fluorescent tube buzzing back on.

Which segment is the forged splice?
choice.c_n067_helyes: "Segment B (23:54–23:56)! There's no blackout hum, and the exact same streetcar bell repeats twice!"
choice.c_n067_rossz_a: "Segment A (23:52–23:54), because 50 Hz hums don't exist in older buildings!"
choice.c_n067_rossz_c: "Segment C (23:56–23:58), because sirens never run along the Grand Boulevard at night!"
choice.c_n067_rossz_d: "Segment D (23:58–00:00), because fluorescent lights never buzz when turning back on!"
node.n068_rejtv4_siker.title: Ilona's Confession in the Smoke
node.n068_rejtv4_siker.text: The moment you call out the looping streetcar bell in Segment B, smugglers draw switchblades and pistols at once. Ilona kicks over the side table with a curse: 'Fine, yes! I cut those two minutes — but when I stepped into the dark at 23:54, the real watch was already gone! A shadow slipped behind the mahogany grandfather clock and left me empty-handed!'
choice.c_n068_menekul: Dive toward the mahogany grandfather clock before shots fly
node.n069_rejtv4_kudarc.title: Blow of the Aluminum Reel
node.n069_rejtv4_kudarc.text: Ilona laughs coldly and cracks the heavy aluminum tape reel across the back of your neck before you can duck (-2 HP). 'Weak guess — and I'm not sticking around for the police!' she snaps, tossing back one parting truth as she bolts: someone else already took the real watch through the grandfather clock at 23:54!
choice.c_n069_menekul: Scramble off the rug and shove open the hidden door of the mahogany clock
node.n070_1979_menekules.title: Call of the 2029 Dial
node.n070_1979_menekules.text: Inside the copper alcove the shimmering vortex still waits, and for one heartbeat the old cellar watchmaker stands by the entrance with his gold signet ring. Silently he points at the 2029 dial: time to go back where you started — carrying the echoes of two altered eras.
choice.c_n070_ugras: Grip the Broken Watch Chain and turn the dial toward 2029
node.n071_harmadik_idougras.title: Plunging Back Into the Neon Future
node.n071_harmadik_idougras.text: Socialist neon signs, grainy newsreels, and cyan crypto holograms melt together around you in a deafening copper spiral. The Broken Watch Chain burns warm in your fist as though pulling you home — yet this third leap tears harder at your bones than any before.
choice.c_n071_idegek: Clench your fist on the chain and hold your mind steady with pure Nerve
choice.c_n071_ugyesseg: Roll cleanly with the temporal shock and hit the 2029 floor on your feet
node.n072_erkezes_2029.title: Back in 2029: The Altered Palace
node.n072_erkezes_2029.text:
You hit the parquet floor of the 2029 Watch Room hard — yet the palace feels quieter, tauter than when you left. Neon rain still lashes the barred window, and in the dust before the copper wall vault sit two fresh footprints.

In the hall, Pötyi's speaker purrs back to life: 'Welcome back to 2029. While you were away… fifty years of files and cables shifted in quite fascinating ways.'
choice.c_n072_tovabb: Pick yourself up and face the reshaped palace of 2029
node.n073_2029_visszateres.title: Echoes of the Past in the Copper Alcove
node.n073_2029_visszateres.text:
You step out from behind the swung-open mahogany clock and immediately feel the building ticking differently around you. The old wall service drawer sits slightly ajar, and the Watch Room lamps hum in amber-red standby.

In the alcove behind you stands the three-dial Time Vault — locked by dials marked 1928, 1979, and 2029. Downstairs, Pötyi's system, Zóra's private suite, and the rooftop still hold answers.
choice.c_n073_uzenet_olvas: Pull open the steel drawer sealed until 2029 — your 1979 note has a reply!
choice.c_n073_tovabb: Slip out into the fourth-floor corridor to survey the reshaped 2029 palace
node.n074_2029_hub.title: 2029: Night of the Two-Way Loop
node.n074_2029_hub.text:
Your smartwatch reads November 11, 2029, just past midnight — to the outside world barely minutes have passed, yet you feel all three eras straining against one another. Down one hall hums Pötyi's chilled server room; down the other gleams the gilded door of Zóra Kálmán's penthouse suite.

Above, the rooftop fire door bangs in the wind as though someone just fled into the rain, while a glowing green first-aid cabinet winks on the wall.
choice.c_n074_potyi: Infiltrate the basement server room to reach Pötyi's AI core
choice.c_n074_zora: Confront Zóra Kálmán in her third-floor private suite
choice.c_n074_teto: Chase the fleeing shadow out onto the neon-drenched rooftop
choice.c_n074_orvosi: Pop open the wall-mounted smart first-aid cabinet for quick patching
choice.c_n074_idoszef: Return to the three-dial Time Vault to open the inner chamber
node.n075_szerverszoba_folyoso.title: Pötyi's Chilled Server Room
node.n075_szerverszoba_folyoso.text: Near-freezing air and cold cyan LEDs greet you in the server corridor. The ceiling speaker clicks on at once, sounding noticeably edgier: 'Halt! My security logs are flashing thirty-seven inexplicable anomalies, and every single one matches your shoe size.'
choice.c_n075_szabotalt_riaszto: Trigger the fault on the relay you sabotaged in 1979 — Pötyi's firewall freezes!
choice.c_n075_potyi_barat: Address Pötyi with polite formality and remind her of your earlier rapport
choice.c_n075_hekkel: Jack into the service terminal and try to outsmart the firewall
choice.c_n075_beront: Don't negotiate with a ceiling speaker — kick through the door toward the lasers
node.n076_szabotazs_hatasa.title: A Fifty-Year Short Circuit
node.n076_szabotazs_hatasa.text: Pötyi's voice slows to a drowsy drawl: 'How curious… voltage fluctuations from the 1979 basement conduit just forced my B-sector into standby. You are tiresomely proactive.' The inner hatch pops open, though the backup laser grid still flickers inside.
choice.c_n076_tovabb: Step up to the flickering laser grid
node.n077_potyi_beszelgetes.title: Pötyi's Polite Betrayal
node.n077_potyi_beszelgetes.text: Pötyi pauses for a beat, then lets out a theatrical sigh clearly copied from a voice actress: 'Well, at least you didn't shove my sensors aside like Zóra Kálmán did. Here is one housekeeping detail from the logs: tonight's blackout lasted exactly 06 minutes — which happens to be your third dial code.'
choice.c_n077_tovabb: Thank her for the 06 code and step into the laser chamber
node.n078_potyi_lezerhalo.title: Dancing Through Red Laser Beams
node.n078_potyi_lezerhalo.text: Before the central server rack, a dense web of red lasers crosses the dark marble. With your 1979 Watchmaker's Phosphor Dust, a single flick illuminates every hidden beam in the air (+2 Agility), though sheer reckless Luck might carry you across too.
choice.c_n078_lezer_ugyesseg: Twist and vault cleanly through the laser grid to the main console
choice.c_n078_lezer_szerencse: Dive across the final two meters on pure reckless Luck
node.n079_potyi_mag.title: The 23:54 Override and the Biometric Keycard
node.n079_potyi_mag.text: Resting on a charging dock sits a spare Biometric VIP Keycard, while the console screen flashes the 23:54 command log in red: Zóra Kálmán used her master credentials to kill Pötyi's cameras for precisely six minutes — from 23:54 to 00:00! That makes the 2029 blackout length exactly 06.
choice.c_n079_kartya: Pocket the Biometric VIP Keycard and save the 06-minute blackout log
node.n080_potyi_logok.title: Pötyi's Parting Remark
node.n080_potyi_logok.text: As you pull the drive from the console, Pötyi's tone turns unusually matter-of-fact: 'One last datum for your trouble: Zóra didn't merely disable the camera. She is hunting a crypto key in the Watch Room that has bound every Kálmán heir in blood for a century.'
choice.c_n080_tovabb: Pocket the warning and head for the rear stairwell
node.n081_szerverszoba_kijarat.title: Back Up Above the Third Floor
node.n081_szerverszoba_kijarat.text: Climbing the service stairs, the whole circuit becomes clear: Zóra cut security for six minutes at 23:54 to pull off a switch — or silence someone — before the guests reached the door.
choice.c_n081_vissza: Step back onto the fourth-floor central corridor
node.n082_zora_lakosztaly_ajto.title: Zóra Kálmán's Emerald Suite
node.n082_zora_lakosztaly_ajto.text: Outside the black oak door of the third-floor penthouse glows a biometric scanner in emerald green. Inside, ice clinks against glass over a low murmur of financial news.
choice.c_n082_kartyaval: Swipe the Biometric VIP Keycard to slip quietly into Zóra's study
choice.c_n082_kopog: Knock boldly and walk straight in to face Zóra
node.n083_zora_szalon.title: The Study Unlocked by Keycard
node.n083_zora_szalon.text: The VIP Keycard pops the service door silently. On Zóra's desk glows an open crypto-liquidation notice: unless she produces the genuine Kálmán Chronometer and family archive by dawn, her creditors auction the palace out from under her. Before you can snoop further, Zóra steps in from the terrace holding a glass of rosé.
choice.c_n083_tovabb: Step out from the shadows and confront Zóra with the facts
node.n084_zora_szembesites.title: Emerald Silk, Blackmail, and a Gun Barrel
node.n084_zora_szembesites.text:
Zóra doesn't flinch — she leans casually against an open wall safe holding a thick leather dossier while spinning a matte-black compact pistol in her free hand. The 1928 Perfumed Letter grants +1 Charm here if you wave her family's dirty laundry in her face.

'Well?' she smiles coldly. 'Did you come for my father's and grandfather's sins, or are you angling for a cut?'
choice.c_n084_bloff_sarm: Play the century-old scandal with wicked charm and talk the dossier out of her hands
choice.c_n084_alku: Flash a conspiratorial grin and offer a deal: walk away rich together tonight
choice.c_n084_elragad: Knock her pistol aside and snatch the dossier straight out of the safe
node.n085_zora_alku_vagy_akta.title: The 100-Year Blackmail Dossier
node.n085_zora_alku_vagy_akta.text: In your hands sits the 100-Year Blackmail Dossier — three generations of illicit deeds, bribed judges, and a 1928 codicil leaving Oszkár Kálmán's entire fortune to a concealed son named Ádám and his line. Zóra's jaw tightens: 'Careful with that. I staged tonight's heist to burn those papers for good — except somebody beat me inside the Watch Room!'
choice.c_n085_akta: Tuck the 100-Year Blackmail Dossier inside your coat
node.n086_zora_pancel.title: Parting Shot from Zóra's Salon
node.n086_zora_pancel.text: Zóra calls after you from the doorway: 'When you find that masked bastard and the real watch upstairs, don't forget whose champagne you drank first tonight!'
choice.c_n086_vissza: Hurry back up to the fourth-floor corridor
node.n087_tetoterasz_kijarat.title: Neon Rain and Temporal Lightning on the Roof
node.n087_tetoterasz_kijarat.text: You shove open the heavy iron rooftop door. Outside, storm rain lashes the slate tiles while blue temporal lightning arcs between Art Nouveau turrets. Sprinting along the ridge toward the roof ladders is a figure in a Venetian brass mask — the very Masked Bidder from the auction!
choice.c_n087_kimegy: Give chase across the slick slate roof
node.n088_tetoterasz_hajsza.title: Chase Across Slick Slate
node.n088_tetoterasz_hajsza.text: Between two stone gargoyles the roof drops away over a deep lightwell while phantom 1928 gas lamps and 1979 TV antennas strobe across the rain. With the 1979 Smuggler's Blueprint, you know exactly where the narrow service catwalk hides (+1 Agility).
choice.c_n088_ugras_ugyesseg: Vault across the slick ridge onto the narrow ledge beside the gargoyle
choice.c_n088_idegek: Refuse to look down and charge straight through the blinding temporal flash
node.n089_vandor_talalkozas.title: The Wanderer's Mask Falls
node.n089_vandor_talalkozas.text:
At the base of the dome you finally corner the masked figure. When they lift the Venetian brass mask, you recognize the lean face and heavy gold signet ring of the 1979 cellar watchmaker — older now, wearing a weary smile.

'I am Ádám Kálmán,' he says quietly in the rain. 'Oszkár's concealed son. Since 1928 I have guarded the Time Vault so neither the Baron, nor state agents, nor Zóra could seize the palace's true heart. Take my journal — meet me in the Watch Room!'
choice.c_n089_naplo: Catch The Wanderer's Pocket Journal before he slips into the mist
node.n090_tetoterasz_vissza.title: Back Inside from the Storm
node.n090_tetoterasz_vissza.text: Soaked to the bone yet clutching the leather journal, you climb back down the roof ladder. Now you know who pulled every invisible thread at 23:54 across all three eras.
choice.c_n090_vissza: Step back into the fourth-floor corridor
node.n091_orvosi_szekreny_2029.title: Nanogel and Caffeine Patch
node.n091_orvosi_szekreny_2029.text: You pop open the smart first-aid cabinet's emergency latch. Pötyi chirps disapprovingly from above, yet two tubes of cooling nanogel and a mint stimulant patch snap your pulse right back into shape (+3 HP).
choice.c_n091_vissza: Shut the cabinet and carry on
node.n092_szef_elott.title: Before the Three-Dial Time Vault
node.n092_szef_elott.text:
You return to the copper alcove behind the mahogany clock. Centered in the wall gleams the massive Time Vault, sealed by three two-digit dials engraved 1928, 1979, and 2029.

The 1928 Tuning-Fork Key hums faintly near the bronze housing (+1 Wits for tuning the dials).
choice.c_n092_hangvilla: Tap the brass frame softly and use Wits to listen past the false clicks
choice.c_n092_egyenest: Skip the preliminaries and dial in the three-era code directly
node.n093_rejtv5_idoszef.title: Logic Puzzle 5: The Time Vault's Three-Era Code
node.n093_rejtv5_idoszef.text:
The Time Vault's three two-digit dials ask for the signature number of each era in order:

• 1928 dial: The fateful minute when Oszkár's pocket watch and the grandfather clock stopped (engraved on the 1928 Tuning-Fork Key).
• 1979 dial: The number from the watchmaker's gear box, and also the November calendar date.
• 2029 dial: The duration in minutes of the 23:54 blackout until midnight.

Which three-number combination unlocks the lever?
choice.c_n093_vakszerencse: Spin the dials blind on one desperate Luck check
node.n094_rejtv5_siker.title: Golden Click of the Time Vault
node.n094_rejtv5_siker.text: 54 – 11 – 06. All three brass dials click at once with the deep resonance of a century-old bell tower striking midnight. The heavy vault door swings wide in warm golden light — revealing the stolen Kálmán Chronometer of all three eras merged back into one flawless, glowing timepiece!
choice.c_n094_belep: Lift the Chronometer and step into the chamber beyond
node.n095_rejtv5_kudarc.title: Arc Discharge and Emergency Release
node.n095_rejtv5_kudarc.text: The wrong setting snaps a blue electrical arc across your wrist (-3 HP) — yet the jolt swings the Broken Watch Chain in your pocket right against the spring latch, snapping the dials into 54 – 11 – 06! Smoking slightly, the heavy vault door grinds open.
choice.c_n095_belep: Shake out your scorched hand and step inside the open Time Vault
node.n096_idoszef_nyilik.title: All Eras Behind One Door
node.n096_idoszef_nyilik.text: Beyond the Time Vault lies no cramped safe, but a timeless mirror-image of the Watch Room itself. Through three tall windows shimmer 1928 gaslights, 1979 Trabant headlights, and 2029 neon rain all at once. Time to close the game.
choice.c_n096_vegszoba: Step into the timeless hall of the Watch Room
node.n097_finale_bevezetes.title: The Three Eras Converge
node.n097_finale_bevezetes.text:
Across the floor of the timeless Watch Room, 1928 cigar smoke, 1979 Traubisoda sweetness, and 2029 ozone tangle together. Around the center table stand three figures locked in standoff: Zóra Kálmán with pistol drawn, the pale silhouettes of Baron Székely and Ilona Kardos in the doorway, and by the hearth unmasked Ádám Kálmán — the Wanderer — holding the softly ticking real Kálmán Chronometer.

'Enough running in circles!' Zóra snaps, leveling the barrel at your chest. 'If you're such a brilliant detective, tell everyone right now what really happened in this house over a hundred years!'
choice.c_n097_tovabb: Step into the crossfire of Kálmán Palace's three eras
node.n098_harmas_talalkozo.title: Pressure of the Time Vortex
node.n098_harmas_talalkozo.text: As all three eras strain to collapse into one room, the air shudders and windowpanes crack. Inside your pocket, the Broken Watch Chain sparks blue (+1 Nerve bonus), helping steady your mind before the final reckoning.
choice.c_n098_idegek: Plant your boots and hold fast against the temporal gale with steel Nerve
choice.c_n098_szerencse: Wink at fate and trust sheer Luck to keep your footing
node.n099_szovetsegesek_hangja.title: Witnesses of the Past Line Up
node.n099_szovetsegesek_hangja.text:
Along the edges of the room shimmer the allies and facts you gathered across three nights: Red Lola's stage alibi, Sunflower Béla's cellar testimony, Pötyi's 23:54 log, and Ádám's quiet confession. Every one of them is watching you.

You must answer three questions in the Final Accusation: who ordered the 2029 staged heist, exactly how the watch vanished on all three nights, and who the mysterious Wanderer really is.
choice.c_n099_kihallgatas: Begin step one of the Final Accusation
node.n100_rejtv6_1_tettes.title: Logic Puzzle 6 (1/3): Who Ordered the 2029 Heist?
node.n100_rejtv6_1_tettes.text: Question One: On November 11, 2029, who used their own biometric master code at 23:54 to kill Pötyi's cameras for six minutes and stage a distraction while erasing the family archive?
choice.c_n100_helyes: "Zóra Kálmán! She overrode Pötyi for six minutes from 23:54 to save her fortune and burn the 100-Year Blackmail Dossier!"
choice.c_n100_rossz_fenyves: "Curator Dr. Fenyves shut down the cameras alone to fence the watch for crypto!"
choice.c_n100_rossz_potyi: "Pötyi the AI gained sentience and unplugged herself out of boredom!"
node.n101_vad1_siker.title: Zóra's Smile Freezes
node.n101_vad1_siker.text: Zóra's eyes narrow as her pistol barrel dips by a single millimeter. 'Clever… though you haven't explained half the alibi yet.'
choice.c_n101_tovabb: Press on to step two of the Final Accusation
node.n102_vad1_kudarc.title: A Wild Shot and Quick Recovery
node.n102_vad1_kudarc.text: Zóra laughs sharply and fires a warning round into an ornamental vase beside you, grazing your arm with flying porcelain (-2 HP). 'Think before you point fingers!' she hisses as you refocus on the next question.
choice.c_n102_tovabb: Steady yourself and state the method for question two
node.n103_rejtv6_2_modszer.title: Logic Puzzle 6 (2/3): How Did the Thrice-Repeated Theft Work?
node.n103_rejtv6_2_modszer.text: Question Two: What single method united every locked-room disappearance across 1928, 1979, and 2029?
choice.c_n103_helyes: "During the six-minute 23:54 blackout, the watch left through the Time Vault behind the pivoting mahogany clock while a staged midnight noise covered the alibi!"
choice.c_n103_rossz_ablak: "In every era, an identically trained carrier pigeon squeezed the watch out through the barred window!"
choice.c_n103_rossz_lift: "The real watch was never in the Watch Room in any era — it was all mass hypnosis!"
node.n104_vad2_siker.title: The Locked-Room Myth Shatters
node.n104_vad2_siker.text: Dead silence falls over the room — even the phantoms of Székely and Ilona nod in stunned acknowledgment. Across every era, the locked-room paradox finally makes sense. Only one name remains.
choice.c_n104_tovabb: Point toward the Wanderer by the hearth for question three
node.n105_vad2_kudarc.title: A Shaky Deduction
node.n105_vad2_kudarc.text: At that desperate guess, Zóra whips her pistol grip sharply against your ribs (-2 HP). 'Don't choke at the finish line, detective!' she snarls while Ádám gestures sadly toward the alcove behind the wall clock.
choice.c_n105_tovabb: Focus on the final question: the Wanderer's true identity
node.n106_rejtv6_3_vandor.title: Logic Puzzle 6 (3/3): Who Is the Wanderer Across All Three Eras?
node.n106_rejtv6_3_vandor.text: Third and final question: Who was the signet-ringed figure — silent apprentice in 1928, cellar watchmaker in 1979, and Masked Bidder in 2029 — who rescued the true Kálmán Chronometer one minute ahead of every thief?
choice.c_n106_helyes: "Ádám Kálmán — Oszkár Kálmán's concealed son and rightful heir, who guarded the watch for a century!"
choice.c_n106_rossz_szekely: "Baron Artúr Székely cloned himself across three different centuries!"
choice.c_n106_rossz_bela: "Sunflower Béla time-jumped from 1979 to corner the 2029 denim market!"
node.n107_vad3_siker.title: Ádám's Smile and the Final Choice
node.n107_vad3_siker.text: Ádám Kálmán bows deeply and sets the gleaming Kálmán Chronometer in the center of the table. 'At last someone speaks my name inside my own house. The game ends in your hands now — what will you do with the watch, the dossier, and all of us?'
choice.c_n107_tovabb: Step up to the table and make your final choice
node.n108_vad3_kudarc.title: The Unspoken Name
node.n108_vad3_kudarc.text: Ádám shakes his head sadly as a final spark from the time vortex bites into your shoulder (-2 HP). 'Not everyone remembers the shadows,' he whispers, placing the Chronometer on the table and leaving the night's outcome to you anyway.
choice.c_n108_tovabb: Grit your teeth and choose your way out of the storm
node.n109_vegso_dontes.title: The Kálmán Chronometer on the Table
node.n109_vegso_dontes.text: In the center of the Watch Room ticks the flawless gold-and-obsidian Kálmán Chronometer, flanked by the evidence you gathered and the open Time Vault. The gate between eras will seal forever in seconds — you decide how this century-old story ends.
choice.c_n109_e3_orasmester: Unite Ádám's Journal with the 1928 Tuning-Fork Key and open the Fourth Timeline
choice.c_n109_e1_leleplezes: Hand the evidence to the law, stop the loop, and close the century-old case clean
choice.c_n109_e2_arany_tolvaj: Pocket the Chronometer and the dossier with a grin and slip away with the fortune
choice.c_n109_e4_menekules: Don't press your luck — bolt out of the collapsing vortex into the 2029 night
node.n110_negyedik_idosik_elott.title: The Fourth Note of the Tuning-Fork Key
node.n110_negyedik_idosik_elott.text: Under Ádám's approving gaze, you fit the 1928 Tuning-Fork Key into a hidden notch on the Chronometer's rim and open his journal's final page. Unexpectedly, the three-dial timepiece unfolds a fourth, previously invisible golden dial — and beyond the wall opens a serene archway bathed in warm amber light.
choice.c_n110_befejezes: Step into the New Clockmaker's Workshop
node.n111_tiszta_lap_elott.title: Silence Before the Final Click
node.n111_tiszta_lap_elott.text: Pötyi's speaker clicks as she summons district prosecutors and the waiting press. Zóra drops her pistol in fury while Ádám calmly shuts the Time Vault's heavy door: the dials for 1928, 1979, and 2029 all come to rest at midnight sharp.
choice.c_n111_befejezes: Turn the Chronometer and close the time loop for good
node.n112_arany_tolvaj_elott.title: Fifty Years' Interest in Your Pocket
node.n112_arany_tolvaj_elott.text: While Zóra and the ghosts argue beneath the red light, you smoothly sweep the Kálmán Chronometer off the table and tuck the 100-Year Blackmail Dossier — complete with crypto keys — beneath your arm. The rooftop door stands wide open, with a fortune waiting outside that makes any auction look like pocket change.
choice.c_n112_befejezes: Slip across the rooftop into the Budapest night with your prize
node.e1_tiszta_lap.title: The Final Click
node.e1_tiszta_lap.text:
The Kálmán Chronometer clicks one last time, and the sparks of the temporal vortex fade gently inside the Watch Room. By the time dawn breaks over Budapest's rooftops, Zóra Kálmán walks down the marble steps in handcuffs and the 100-Year Blackmail Dossier hits every screen in the city.

Ádám Kálmán tips his hat one last time from the street before strolling away in peace, while Pötyi chimes politely in the lobby: 'Congratulations. Your soles are still damp, yet your sense of justice is exemplary.' You solved the mystery of the thrice-stolen watch — clean, sharp, and final.
node.e2_arany_tolvaj.title: Fifty Years with Interest
node.e2_arany_tolvaj.text:
The rain has already stopped on the slate roof as you vault effortlessly onto the neighboring terrace — carrying the gleaming Kálmán Chronometer and the dossier holding the Kálmán fortune inside your coat.

Next morning the papers speculate wildly about a 'phantom heist' at Kálmán Palace while you order a second cognac on a Vienna café terrace. Baron Székely and Zóra can hunt the culprit for another fifty years — you just won yourself a century.
node.e3_uj_orasmester.title: The Fourth Timeline
node.e3_uj_orasmester.text:
Together, the Tuning-Fork Key and Ádám's Journal awaken the Kálmán Chronometer's hidden fourth dial. The Watch Room walls dissolve into warm golden mist, revealing a quiet Clockmaker's Sanctum suspended above all three eras — where 1928, 1979, and 2029 can be watched and mended at once.

Ádám Kálmán smiles and slips his heavy gold signet ring into your palm: 'I am too old for time now, my friend. From tonight on, the palace clocks are yours — and maybe one day in 1928 we'll share another drink with Lola and Béla.' You unlocked the adventure's deepest secret ending.
node.e4_felemas_alku.title: An Unfinished Game
node.e4_felemas_alku.text:
You sprint out of the collapsing alcove just as the hidden chamber behind the mahogany wall clock seals shut with a thunderous boom. Out on the dawn-lit Grand Boulevard sirens wail, Zóra has vanished into the mist, and the Kálmán Chronometer remains entombed behind the walls.

You survived, and the handful of vintage relics in your pocket would still fetch a tidy sum from private collectors — yet listening to rain tap the pavement, you sometimes feel as if an unseen pendulum above your head still stops at 23:54.
